text.p: The following are the leading stories in the Maltese press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- New date set for removal of Value Added Tax. Prime Minister Alfred Sant said a system to replace VAT will be in place by the end of summer. The government, elected late in October, originally said the new system would be in place within six months.

- New Drydocks Council to meet relatives of nine workers killed in explosion on Libyan tanker in drydock on February 3, 1995. Dockyard has been blamed for the incident but the relatives are in dispute with the yard over compensation.
- Four women injured in traffic accident.
